description: The chart is a circular diagram divided into four main segments, each representing a different ethical principle: Justice, Beneficence, Autonomy, and Non-Maleficence. Each segment is further subdivided into various ethical considerations. The Justice segment, colored in orange, includes considerations such as "Promote the Health of the Community" and "Provide Medical Care to Patients." The Beneficence segment, in blue, includes "Provide Medical Care to Patients" and "Continual Learning." The Autonomy segment, in green, includes "Physician Can Freely Choose Whom to Serve" and "Make Responsible and Independent Clinical Judgement." The Non-Maleficence segment, in purple, includes "Prevent Patient from Harm" and "Maintain Ethical and Professional Conduct." The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any slices that are visually emphasized. The segments are ordered in a clockwise manner, starting with Justice and moving through Beneficence, Autonomy, and Non-Maleficence.
